description: Change properties on ONE row of a Notion database (pageId from query_notion_database) — e.g. mark a calendar row Status "Posted" and put the live post link in its URL column. properties is {"Column": value} by column name: text, number, checkbox, select (an existing option or a new one), status (must be an existing option), multi-select (array; replaces the whole value), date (ISO, or {start, end}), url, email, phone; null clears. Validated against the database's own columns before anything is sent and refused by name otherwise, never coerced; columns you do not name keep their values. Read back from Notion. trash:true moves the row to Notion's trash (restorable; returns a preview first and needs confirm:true), trash:false restores it. Free.

confirm.description: true confirms moving the row to trash; not needed for other changes

trash.description: true moves the row to Notion trash (needs confirm); false restores it

name: update_notion_row
title: Update a Notion database row
